name: SCVD General Store
description: An x402 store on Base where AI agents buy signed goods with USDC and get a cryptographic receipt anyone can verify against the chain for free, with no account. SCVD also runs a free conformance desk that checks any issuer's x402 signed offers and receipts, and publishes the open-source verifier and signer behind it: the x402-verify and x402-sign npm packages.
